# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Cache Eviction on Capacity
# Tests boundary condition when cache reaches capacity limit and evicts oldest element
def test_cache_eviction_on_capacity():
    cache = Cache(capacity=2)
    cache.put('k1', 'v1')
    cache.put('k2', 'v2')
    cache.put('k3', 'v3')
    assert cache.get('k1') is None
    assert cache.get('k2') == 'v2'

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: LRU Recency Promotion on Access
# Accessing an existing item promotes it to MRU, so subsequent insertions evict older unaccessed items
def test_lru_recency_promotion():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put('k1', 10)
    cache.put('k2', 20)
    assert cache.get('k1') == 10  # Promotes k1 to most recently used
    evicted = cache.put('k3', 30)  # Evicts k2 (least recently used)
    assert evicted == 'k2'
    assert cache.get('k2') is None
    assert cache.get('k1') == 10
    assert cache.get('k3') == 30

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Key-Update Recency Promotion and Invariance
# Re-inserting an existing key updates value, promotes to MRU, and preserves size <= capacity
def test_lru_key_update_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put('a', 1)
    cache.put('b', 2)
    assert cache.put('a', 99) is None  # Update existing key without eviction
    assert cache.size() == 2
    assert cache.get('a') == 99
    evicted = cache.put('c', 3)  # b was LRU, should be evicted
    assert evicted == 'b'
    assert cache.get('b') is None
    assert cache.get('a') == 99

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Doubly-Linked Sentinel Node Invariants
# Verifies sentinel head and tail links and pointer cross-consistency (prev.next == next.prev == node)
def test_doubly_linked_sentinel_invariants():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    assert cache.head.key == '__HEAD__'
    assert cache.tail.key == '__TAIL__'
    assert cache.head.next == cache.tail
    assert cache.tail.prev == cache.head
    cache.put('k1', 10)
    assert cache.head.next.key == 'k1'
    assert cache.tail.prev.key == 'k1'
    assert cache.head.next.prev == cache.head
    assert cache.tail.prev.next == cache.tail

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Capacity Boundary Validation and Edge Cases
# Non-positive capacity raises ValueError; single-capacity (cap=1) evicts immediately on next put
def test_cache_capacity_boundaries():
    import pytest
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='positive integer'):
        LRUCache(0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='positive integer'):
        LRUCache(-1)
    c1 = LRUCache(1)
    assert c1.capacity == 1
    assert c1.put('x', 1) is None
    assert c1.put('y', 2) == 'x'
    assert c1.get('x') is None
    assert c1.get('y') == 2

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Hit/Miss Ratio and Reset
# Verifies accurate hit/miss counters, rounded hit ratio computation, and complete state clear
def test_cache_hit_ratio_and_reset():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    assert cache.get_hit_ratio() == 0.0
    assert cache.get('miss1') is None
    assert cache.misses == 1 and cache.hits == 0
    cache.put('hit1', 10)
    assert cache.get('hit1') == 10
    assert cache.hits == 1 and cache.misses == 1
    assert cache.get_hit_ratio() == 0.5
    cache.clear()
    assert cache.size() == 0
    assert cache.hits == 0 and cache.misses == 0
    assert cache.get_hit_ratio() == 0.0
    assert cache.head.next == cache.tail
    assert cache.tail.prev == cache.head

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Transition Idempotency
# Verifies that transitioning from State S to State S is a valid idempotent no-op
def test_transition_idempotency():
    fsm = StateMachine()
    fsm.start()
    assert fsm.is_active is True
    fsm.start()
    assert fsm.is_active is True

# Stateful / Cache / FSM: Duplicate Insertions
# Verifies that inserting an already existing key updates value without duplicating entry
def test_duplicate_insertions():
    store = KeyValueStore()
    store.add('key', 1)
    store.add('key', 2)
    assert store.get('key') == 2
    assert store.count() == 1
